comment: Wes was an OUTSTANDING professor. I was only taking this course as a prerequisite for physics, but it ended up being my favorite class of the semester. His tests are tough and you will have to study a lot but he is incredibly fair and clear in his instruction and grading. Excellent in office hours, excellent in lecture, excellent professor.

If you haven't taken calc before, you might struggle a bit and have to put in some extra work. If you have already, this class is a breeze. Homework is due weekly and generally not to excessive, but is graded. Tests are annoying, but not too unreasonable. Cain's biggest issue is that he's too wordy when writing notes.  Nice enough guy, though.
Nice teacher. Patient and kind. Skilled at applied math teaching. I wanna be in his class again next term!
Quirky but an awesome teacher.  Knows his stuff, but definitely make sure to ask if you don't understand; he'll help no problem and explain it perfectly. Highly recommended.
